finalOutput:
Created `snake_ollama-mimo-v2.6-flash-rl-mxfp4_01.html` — a complete single-file Snake game with:

- **30×30 grid** rendered on a 600×600 canvas with subtle grid lines
- **Continuous movement** at fixed tick interval; snake grows on eating food
- **Wall & self collision** ends the game (head-on collisions between snakes too)
- **Keyboard controls**: P1 = WASD, P2 = arrow keys
- **CPU AI**: BFS shortest-path to food with a fallback safe-move search when blocked
- **Three modes**: Human vs Human, CPU vs Human, CPU vs CPU
- **Live score HUD** (P1/P2 + current mode label)
- **Start menu** with keyboard (1/2/3, ↑/↓, Enter) or mouse selection
- **Game over screen** with winner/reason and scores
- **Restart with keypress**: R or Enter to replay, Esc back to menu
